title: War in the Red Badlands
changes: The Red Badlands join the clan war: ten badlands territories held by the Redfang clan, whose seat is now Fangrock.
The Red Pass joins the badlands to the Oakvale Lands on the war table. Redfang Hollow and Dustrider Camp are no longer Redfang capitals and can be taken.
The Rustwater Post bounty board now offers war writs for the badlands. The Rustwater Post, Fangrock Keep and the open badlands stay out of the war.
